meta.source: German Vocabulary A1-B2 (clean rebuild, composed for this project)
meta.sourceNote: Every word, gloss and example sentence in this app was composed for it. Nothing is taken from an exam board's list, a publisher's word list or a dictionary, so the vocabulary carries no third-party licensing question.
meta.cefrNote: Each list states the level of the words it contains. A word that appears in more than one list is filed at the lowest of them.

frequency.note: Word forms ranked by frequency in film and television subtitles. This is a list of surface forms, not lemmas, and it skews spoken and colloquial German. It is not a CEFR list and implies nothing about level.
